notes.title: Free demo now available!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the Chompy Chomp Chomp Party Demo, and we can't wait for you to experience the multiplayer madness firsthand. Prepare for a wild ride filled with laughter, competition, and chomping galore!

🎉 Unlimited Chase and Chomp: Dive into the heart-pounding action of our signature game mode, where you'll be chasing and chomping your way through chaotic levels with up to 8 players. Grab your friends, family, or foes, and brace yourselves for an unforgettable multiplayer experience!

🎵 Disco Delight: Immerse yourself in the dazzling disco-themed levels, complete with vibrant visuals, funky beats, and mesmerising environments. It's a party atmosphere that will have you grooving while you chomp!

💥 Unleash the Vortex Power-Up: Introducing the brand-new Vortex power-up, a game-changer that will teleport your opponents to different parts of the level. Strategically drop a vortex and watch as the game takes an unexpected twist. It's time to outsmart your rivals and seize victory!

🚀 Stack Up the Power-Ups: Prepare for even more strategic gameplay with the ability to stack up to 3 power-ups. Carefully choose your arsenal and unleash them at the perfect moment to turn the tides in your favour. It's all about timing, tactics, and tactical chomping!

Ready to dive into the Chompy Chomp Chomp Party? Click on the Download Demo button on the Steam Page. Gather your friends, organise multiplayer mayhem, and share unforgettable moments together.

Your feedback is important to us! If you enjoyed playing Chompy Chomp Chomp Party, we would greatly appreciate it if you could take a moment to write a review on Steam. Your review will not only help us improve the game but also guide other players in making an informed decision. We value every opinion and want to hear about your experience with the game, whether positive or negative. Additionally, your review could help the game gain more exposure and reach more players. So, please take a few minutes to share your thoughts and leave a review. We're all ears and can't wait to hear your stories!

Don't forget to wishlist Chompy Chomp Chomp Party to stay up-to-date with the latest news, updates, and future releases. The party is just getting started, and we're thrilled to have you on board!

notes.title: Introducing the Vortex Power Up in Chompy Chomp Chomp Party!
notes.notes:
I’m excited to announce a brand new feature in Chompy Chomp Chomp Party - the Vortex power up! This power up adds a whole new dimension of strategy and excitement to the game, allowing players to teleport themselves and their opponents to different places on the level.

The Vortex is a power up that players can lay on the floor. Once activated, it creates a swirling vortex. Players caught in the vortex will be teleported to a random location on the level, giving them a chance to escape danger or surprise their opponents.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43098612/5a46dda7728571b9ef8544012f61e58101a3efce.gif[/img]

This new power up is a game-changer, adding an extra layer of unpredictability to each match. Players will need to be quick on their feet and adapt to the new challenges posed by the Vortex power up. Whether you're trying to escape a pursuing opponent or catch them off guard, this item is sure to keep you on your toes. When you add it to the stackable power ups feature in the last release, you can rotate through 3 stored power ups to strategise about when to use it, it adds a new layer of defend and attack. We’ve been screaming in excitement playing it at home.

So start experimenting with the Vortex power up in Chompy Chomp Chomp Party today! Really looking forward to seeing how players use this new feature to outsmart and outmanoeuvre their opponents.

[b]ALSO... Demo launching Soon![/b]

The original Chase & Chomp Mode will be available to play for free. Unlimited games for up to 8 players in the disco theme levels on Steam and Switch. Keep your eyes peeled!

notes.title: Chompy Chomp Chomp Party - Version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hi!

Thank you so much for your support over this release period. I really appreciate it. If you have time to give me a review of Chompy Chomp Chomp Party, I would appreciate it a lot!

Here are the first tweaks and revisions based on feedback from players so far. I'm always looking to improve the game, so if you have feedback or need support, please email support@utopianworldofsandwiches.com and I'll take a look to see what I can do! This will help me to create the best multiplayer experience I can.

New Feature: Stackable Power Ups
	• Ability to store 3 power ups and cycle through them with a button to choose which one to use

Tweaks and Bug Fixes:
	• Invisibility for ghost revision to make you completely invisible
	• Fixed being unable to start game with keyboard controls
	• Correct buttons now displayed on How To Play Switch controller
	• Pink Chompy is paler, was too often confused with the purple Chompy
	• Default option on end game screen to "set up new game" (originally "change options")

Improved bubble power up:
	• Empty bubble now exists for 1.5 seconds from 2.0 seconds
	• Chompy is caught in bubble for 2.0 seconds instead of 2.5
	• Reduced bubble speed 
	• Shrink bubble until target acquired to improve ability to evade and target
	• Added bubble pop
	• Empty bubble ignores already bubbled chompies

I have some more updates coming soon, so keep an eye out!

Thanks,
Woody
